text:
Lee: kicking off migration: add `profile_last_seen` TIMESTAMP + partial TTL index on inactive users. Quiet window 30m. tagging @deploybot to start chunked backfill. pls ack and surface holdpoints.

deploybot: started job mig-3177777000 on pg-cluster-9. chunked mode (chunk_size=2500). auto-pause if lock_wait>10s or replica_lag>55s for >90s. logs -> https://deploy/logs/mig-3177777000 :robot_face:

Anita: any analytics jobs that touch users table this hour?

Colm: moved the hourly cohort job earlier. i'm throttling the ad-hoc report generator to 0.2 qps and draining rr-us-central: `/drain-rr rr-us-central --table=users --timeout=12m`

Ben: adding to release notes: "add profile_last_seen + TTL enforcement; migration during quiet window; read-compatible." pinning to release v2.2.0-canary.

SRE-Oncall: please spell out pause vs rollback criteria and the escape hatch command. also request temporary p95 write latency alert.

Lee: Pause (soft hold) triggers: any lock_wait >10s OR replica_lag >55s sustained >90s OR p95 write latency >300ms for >3m -> deploybot will pause and post holdpin. Full rollback triggers: migration fails 2x OR sustained write errors >35% of writes for 5m OR customer error spike >2.5% for 3m. Escape hatch: `release:abort-mig-3177777000` to pin and stop. Quick rollback snippet:
```
# stop migrator
systemctl stop migrator || true
# terminate running ALTERs
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'ALTER TABLE users' AND state <> 'idle';
# revert schema
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS profile_last_seen;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_users_profile_last_seen_ttl_partial;
```
Full runbook: /runbooks/migrations/users_profile_last_seen.md

deploybot: acknowledged. progress: processed_rows=12,400; throughput ~140 rows/s; no pause conditions yet. posting perf snapshot to metrics.

Anita: i'll watch planner output. ping me if you want EXPLAIN ANALYZE on an active chunk.

Colm: drain complete, replica lag ~7-10s. tailing.

Ben: release note also includes gating: TTL enforcement enabled after 7 days of validation. cc @product for heads-up. :memo:

SRE-Oncall: setting ephemeral alert: alert if write_p95 > 350ms or replica_lag > 60s. will mute low-priority alerts for the window.

Lee: thanks. next checkpoint at 30k rows processed or if deploybot posts a holdpin. standing by.
